title: Occult Ritual Mask
description: A highly detailed ceremonial mask centered against a dark background. The mask is split vertically with the left side depicting cosmic horror elements including a horned demonic entity emerging from blue and orange flames, arcane symbols, and an open spellbook, while the right side features a red-eyed spider-like creature, runes, and mystical diagrams.
prompt: A close-up of an ornate ceremonial mask split in two distinct halves, left side shows a black horned demon rising from blue and orange flames surrounded by glowing runes and an open ancient spellbook, right side features a red spider-like creature with one large eye and mystical symbols, the mask has a realistic human nose and lips, dramatic lighting with purple smoke, highly detailed surreal occult artwork
